message: 頼りにしてる

name: Sally
message: 「Puhyaa~! Everyone's so strong~」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew...」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like I've kind of got the hang of it...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Good work out there, Sakura-kun.」

name: Melilot
message: 「How is your physical condition?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm a little tired, but... I think I'll be fine.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Truly? You aren't pushing yourself too hard?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm fine, see?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see...」

name: Melilot
message: 「If that is the case, then it is alright, however...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Melilot-san, you're surprisingly a worrywart, aren't you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Th-That is not true at all!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I always act in accordance with calm and collected judgment.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is just... because it is you, Sakura-kun, I end up worrying a bit more than usual...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, Melilot-san...」

name: Macaron
message: 「What's this, what's this? Did Big Brother get caught cheating?」

name: Sally
message: 「Cheating!? That definitely doesn't sound tasty!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now, now, playing favorites with only the President isn't right. Please be gentle with me, too.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ah, no, I wasn't particularly...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha... Yeah, yeah, it's nothing at all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The way you're playing dumb makes it seem kinda suspicious, though.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's probably just Sakura-kun acting all spoiled around Melilot-san anyway.」

name: Ria
message: 「Aren't you two getting a liiittle too close~... just kidding\s07」

name: Melilot
message: 「Th-That's why I'm telling you, it's nothing like that!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I only have to train Synn-kun so we can avert Re-Crea, that's all...」

name: Helena
message: 「And before you knew it, you two started getting all conscious of each other, right!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hyaah!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, is everyone working hard? I brought some refreshments for you♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Yaaay, snacks~\s04」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hey, Helena...」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, Melilot. It's totally obvious even if you try to hide it. Mufufu...」

name: Melilot
message: 「W-What are you saying I'm hiding!\s03」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey, where are the yummy snacks~?」

name: Helena
message: 「Ah, sorry to disappoint, but it's not snacks~」

name: Helena
message: 「It's the Kujou family's secret pit viper drink\s05」

name: Ria
message: 「That's news to me...\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's looking... The snake is looking right at me...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Whoa... How do I put it, creepy-cute?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oho, creepy-pitiful, you say? It does indeed look quite pitiful.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, you're telling us to drink this?」

name: Helena
message: 「Apparently it gives you a huge boost of energy?」

name: Ria
message: 「'Apparently,' she says...\s02」

name: Sally
message: 「Kinda looks like honey color though, so it looks yummy!」

name: Helena
message: 「This'll get Synn-chan all perked right up too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Perked up what!」

name: Helena
message: 「Come now, gulp down a cup!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Snakes are creepy-cute, sure, but I'm not gonna lose!」

name: Sally
message: 「Me too! Bottoms up!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Gulp, gulp...」

name: Sally
message: 「Glug-glug!」

name: Macaron & Sally
message: 「Gross!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well then, let's end today's special training here」

name: Melilot
message: 「Good work today, everyone」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah! I'm beat!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm totally wiped out...」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm so hungry I could die...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez, seriously. You guys are so pathetic right from day one」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? So you're gonna keep joining us from now on, Macaron?」

name: Macaron
message: 「H-Hmph. Only if I feel like it」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, I'm heading home for today. Bye-bye!」

name: Synn
message: 「She's still got plenty of energy...」

name: Melilot
message: 「You look like you still have some energy to spare yourself, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Haha, well, I can't exactly collapse in front of you, Melilot-san」

name: Melilot
message: 「Oh my, I didn't think I was being quite that Spartan with my training?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, that's not what I meant...」
I mean, how do I put it--I just can't let her see me looking uncool...

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee...」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, please don't push yourself too hard, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes. I don't want to cause you any trouble, Melilot-san.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, well...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I wouldn't mind if it's just a little, though...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ah, no, it's nothing...」
Does that mean it's okay to rely on her just a little bit.
Melilot-san has started responding when I call out to her!!

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey, are we gonna keep doing this every single day?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek! My body won't be able to take it at all!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Look, I'm shaking like a newborn piglet!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well, even I wouldn't go so far as to say every day.」

name: Melilot
message: 「We will take weekends off, so please use that time to recharge your energy.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It would be troublesome if it interfered with the next special training session, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, what a slave driver...」

name: Ria
message: 「It's fine. Before long, it'll start feeling good\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, that's a little...」

name: Misa
message: 「Feeling good with Onee-sama... haaah\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's do our best to protect the world!」

name: Sally
message: 「Sure must be nice being so carefree~」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, Melilot-san.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, what is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「On the days off from special training, what about the library...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Let's see.」

name: Melilot
message: 「As long as there's no particular reason to close, the schedule will proceed as usual, though」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
So if there is a reason, that means she'll make time for it, right....

name: Melilot
message: 「Is there something on your mind?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, well...」

name: Synn
message: 「Would it be alright if you kept a little time open for me...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I don't mind, but... why do you ask?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, if you don't mind...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd like you to keep me company...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Oh my, is it for individual practice or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? No, uh...」

name: Melilot
message: 「How dedicated. I think that's a wonderful attitude」

name: Synn
message: 「A-ahaha... *sigh*...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is something the matter?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, well... something like that...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Very well, I shall gladly accompany you」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks...」
Once it gets to this point, it's already too late.
It's pretty hard to correct myself and say I wanted to go out somewhere together.
Especially since I've finally gotten closer to Melilot-san than before....
I was thinking I wanted to spend more time with Melilot-san and close that distance even further, though.
Becoming conscious of that all over again makes me feel kind of embarrassed.
Still, today's promise....
I guess I can count this as having secured a promise to spend time together alone, more or less....
